Guoyapos International Airport is located in the south of Guoyapos. Initially, it primarily served foreign tourists visiting the area. At the onset of the North-South Conflict, the airport undertook the important task of evacuating expatriates. As the war progressed, it was temporarily used by both sides as a frontline command center and underwent corresponding military modifications.
